## What this is

Raw-synapse-count version of `panel_K_heatmap.pdf`. Rows = AN09B017 variants
a-g plus AN05B035 (the GABAergic sign inverter). Columns = mAL subtypes.
Values = **raw synapse count** (from `adj.matrix.raw`), unsigned (the relay
identity is reported in the row annotation).

```{r build}
an09_types <- c("AN09B017a", "AN09B017b", "AN09B017c", "AN09B017d",
                "AN09B017e", "AN09B017f", "AN09B017g")
relay_types <- c(an09_types, "AN05B035")
relay_rows_present <- intersect(relay_types, rownames(adj.matrix.raw))
mal_cols_present   <- intersect(mal_subtypes,  colnames(adj.matrix.raw))

mat_raw <- as.matrix(adj.matrix.raw[relay_rows_present, mal_cols_present])
# Pad to full row/col sets
mat <- matrix(0, length(relay_types), length(mal_subtypes),
              dimnames = list(relay_types, mal_subtypes))
mat[relay_rows_present, mal_cols_present] <- mat_raw
cat("Raw synapse range:", range(mat), " non-zero cells:", sum(mat != 0), "\n")

relay_nt <- sapply(relay_types, function(t) {
  r <- mba %>% filter(type == t) %>% pull(consensus_nt)
  if (length(r) == 0) return("unknown")
  r <- r[!is.na(r) & r != ""]
  if (length(r) == 0) "unknown" else names(sort(table(r), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
})

# Per-AN09 input-selectivity label (reused from panel K definition)
relay_selectivity <- sapply(relay_types, function(t) {
  if (t == "AN05B035") return("sign_inverter")
  ppk23 <- conn %>% filter(post_type == t, pre_type == "ppk23") %>%
    summarise(w = sum(weight, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% pull(w)
  ppk25 <- conn %>% filter(post_type == t, pre_type == "ppk25") %>%
    summarise(w = sum(weight, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% pull(w)
  if (length(ppk23) == 0) ppk23 <- 0
  if (length(ppk25) == 0) ppk25 <- 0
  ratio <- log2((ppk23 + 1) / (ppk25 + 1))
  if (ratio > 1)      "ppk23-biased"
  else if (ratio < -1) "ppk25-biased"
  else                 "balanced"
})

row_annot <- data.frame(
  neurotransmitter  = relay_nt,
  input_selectivity = relay_selectivity,
  row.names         = relay_types
)

mal_dim <- setNames(mal_dimorphism[mal_subtypes], mal_subtypes)
col_annot <- data.frame(
  dimorphism = mal_dim[mal_subtypes],
  row.names  = mal_subtypes
)

selectivity_colors <- c(
  "ppk23-biased" = "#D62728",
  "ppk25-biased" = "#2CA02C",
  "balanced"     = "#1F77B4",
  "sign_inverter"= "#000000"
)
relay_nt_colors <- nt_colors[intersect(names(nt_colors), unique(relay_nt))]
if (!"unknown" %in% names(relay_nt_colors) && "unknown" %in% relay_nt)
  relay_nt_colors <- c(relay_nt_colors, unknown = "grey60")

ann_colors <- list(
  neurotransmitter  = relay_nt_colors,
  input_selectivity = selectivity_colors,
  dimorphism        = dimorphism_colors
)
```

## Heatmap

```{r heatmap, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
max_val <- max(mat); if (max_val == 0) max_val <- 1
breaks  <- seq(0, max_val, length.out = 101)
colors  <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "#FDD49E", "#FDBB84", "#EF6548",
                               "#D7301F", "#990000"))(100)

n_cols <- ncol(mat)
cw <- min(28, max(14, 500 / n_cols))
fig_w <- max(10, n_cols * cw / 72 + 4)

for (ext in c("png", "pdf")) {
  save_heatmap_fixed_annot(
    mat        = mat,
    row_annot  = row_annot,
    col_annot  = col_annot,
    ann_colors = ann_colors,
    filename   = file.path(panel_plot_dir("panel_K_heatmap_raw", ext),
                            paste0("panel_K_heatmap_raw.", ext)),
    width = fig_w, height = 5,
    breaks = breaks, color = colors,
    cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = TRUE,
    clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
    clustering_method = "ward.D2",
    fontsize_row = 11, fontsize_col = 10,
    border_color = NA, cellwidth = cw, cellheight = 22,
    display_numbers = TRUE, number_format = "%.0f"
  )
}

cat("Saved raw-synapse heatmap (", nrow(mat), "x", ncol(mat),
    "); max = ", max_val, "\n", sep="")

# Top connections
top <- which(mat > 0, arr.ind = TRUE)
if (nrow(top) > 0) {
  top_df <- data.frame(
    relay = rownames(mat)[top[, 1]],
    mAL   = colnames(mat)[top[, 2]],
    syn   = mat[top]
  ) %>% arrange(desc(syn)) %>% head(10)
  cat("\nTop 10 relay -> mAL connections (raw synapses):\n")
  print(top_df)
}
```
